scripts.start: npm run replica && npm run deploy-local && npm run decl && npm run frontends
scripts.frontends: npm run start-registry & npm run start-docs & npm run start-blog & npm run start-cli-releases
scripts.replica: icp network stop -e local 2>/dev/null; rm -rf .icp/cache/networks .icp/cache/mappings && icp network start --background -e local
scripts.decl: npm run decl:cli && npm run decl:frontend
scripts.decl:cli: npm run decl:cli:main && npm run decl:cli:bench
scripts.decl:cli:main: mops generate candid main -o cli/declarations/main/main.did && icp-bindgen --did-file cli/declarations/main/main.did --out-dir cli/declarations/main --declarations-flat --actor-disabled --force
scripts.decl:cli:bench: mops generate candid bench -o cli/declarations/bench/bench.did && icp-bindgen --did-file cli/declarations/bench/bench.did --out-dir cli/declarations/bench --declarations-flat --actor-disabled --force
scripts.deploy-staging: NODE_ENV=production IDENTITY=mops ICP_ENVIRONMENT=staging npm run deploy
scripts.deploy-ic: NODE_ENV=production IDENTITY=mops ICP_ENVIRONMENT=ic npm run deploy
scripts.build-cli: npm run prepare-cli && npm run release-cli
scripts.postinstall: (cd frontend && npm install) && (cd cli && npm install) && (cd docs && npm install) && (cd blog && npm install) && (cd cli-releases && npm install)
scripts.ci:postinstall: (cd frontend && npm ci) & p1=$!; (cd cli && npm ci) & p2=$!; (cd docs && npm ci) & p3=$!; (cd blog && npm ci) & p4=$!; (cd cli-releases && npm ci) & p5=$!; wait $p1 && wait $p2 && wait $p3 && wait $p4 && wait $p5
scripts.ci:postinstall:sites: (cd frontend && npm ci) & p1=$!; (cd docs && npm ci) & p2=$!; (cd blog && npm ci) & p3=$!; (cd cli-releases && npm ci) & p4=$!; wait $p1 && wait $p2 && wait $p3 && wait $p4
